# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Age:** Over sixty  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Widow  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and community organizer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Agatha Sowerby  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>; Mrs. Sowerby  <sub>[v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Agatha is a stout, heavy woman whose gait is described as a waddle. She has a broad, round face and takes pride in her proficiency as a homemaker and knit quilt producer.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038)_

## Personality

Agatha Sowerby is an exceptionally proficient, observant, and candid woman who takes pride in expressing her mind freely without fear or partiality. She maintains a vigilant watch over Brierley's thoroughfares, involving herself deeply in the personal affairs and morals of her neighbors while efficiently directing local religious and community societies. Though often viewed as meddlesome, bossy, and critical of others' appearances or choices, she possesses a fundamentally kind heart, acts as a devoted caregiver during illness, and readily admits her mistakes when proven wrong.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038), [v1 c26 P0](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0000)_

## History

Agatha Sowerby resides in Sowerby's Hollow, Brierley, where she keeps a watchful eye on all local passersby from her kitchen window while producing cotton-warp quilts. When Obed Abernethy surprisingly travels to Alder River to fetch an orphan, Agatha investigates and discovers that Thirza Abernethy intended to adopt a boy, though an error resulted in bringing home Nell Harcourt instead. Agatha initially criticizes the adoption and later insults Nell's freckles and red hair, causing Nell to fly into a fiery rage. After Nell apologizes, Agatha forgives her and comes to affectionally support the orphan. Following the death of her quiet husband, Thomas Sowerby, Agatha is left in financial difficulty due to an old mortgage. Thirza invites her to move into Grey Shutters, where Agatha establishes her own living quarters in the former spare room and assists with raising the Farrow twins. She continues her active role in Brierley's community affairs, guiding the Ladies' Aid Society bazaar and remaining an opinionated pillar of the village.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c9 P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021)_

- Raised ten children and buried two  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Lived in Brierley near Sowerby's Hollow for decades  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Prominent leader of the Sewing Circle, Sunday-school, Church Aid Society, and Foreign Missions Auxiliary  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Quotes

> Following tea, I will simply pop over to Grey Shutters and ascertain from Thirza his destination and reasoning.  <sub>[v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005)</sub>

> Well, Thirza, I’m simply going to state plainly that I believe you are doing an extremely silly thing—a hazardous thing, that is what.  <sub>[v1 c1 P25](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0025)</sub>

> Well, they didn’t choose you on account of your appearance, that’s without a doubt.  <sub>[v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)</sub>

> Blessed are they who expect nothing for they shall not be disappointed.  <sub>[v1 c13 P19](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0019)</sub>
